title: DCM-SAM: Defect-Conditioned Mixture of LoRA Experts for NPU-Deployed AM Defect Segmentation
abstract: arXiv:2609.38811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Metal additive manufacturing parts are inspected by X-ray computed tomography, where labelled data is scarce, the pores and inclusions that matter span a few pixels, and inspection must happen at the machine. We present DCM-SAM, a defect-conditioned adaptive mixture of LoRA experts: one frozen Segment Anything backbone carries a separate Conv-LoRA expert bank and mask decoder per defect class, each trained in its own pass, without prompts, on synthetic slices alone, updating only 4.4% of the parameters. On benchmarks that XCT-SAM reports, DCM-SAM improves on every baseline for both classes from a ViT-B backbone against their ViT-H, and reaches 64.2% pore IoU on real NIST scans having seen no real images during training. Deployment then exposes what adaptation work rarely measures: on a Qualcomm Hexagon NPU, ViT-H and ViT-L compile yet cannot allocate at 1024x1024 image resolution, since activations rather than weights exceed the device

translated_title: DCM-SAM：面向NPU部署的增材制造缺陷分割的缺陷条件化LoRA专家混合模型
translated_abstract: 金属增材制造零件通过X射线计算机断层扫描（XCT）进行检测，其中标注数据稀缺，关键的孔隙和夹杂物仅占几个像素，且检测必须在机器端进行。我们提出了DCM-SAM，一种缺陷条件化的自适应LoRA专家混合模型：一个冻结的Segment Anything主干网络为每个缺陷类别配备独立的Conv-LoRA专家库和掩码解码器，每类缺陷在各自的训练过程中进行训练，无需提示，仅使用合成切片，且仅更新4.4%的参数。在XCT-SAM报告的基准测试中，DCM-SAM使用ViT-B主干网络在两个缺陷类别上均超越了使用ViT-H的所有基线方法，并在训练期间从未见过任何真实图像的情况下，在真实的NIST扫描上达到了64.2%的孔隙IoU。部署阶段还揭示了模型适应性研究中很少被测量的问题：在Qualcomm Hexagon NPU上，ViT-H和ViT-L虽然能够编译，但在1024×1024图像分辨率下无法完成内存分配，因为激活值（而非权重）超出了设备的限制。
tldr: 提出DCM-SAM，一种基于缺陷条件的LoRA专家混合模型，仅用合成数据训练且只更新4.4%的参数，在从未见过真实图像的情况下于NIST真实扫描上达到64.2%的孔隙IoU，同时揭示了ViT-H/ViT-L因激活内存超出设备限制而无法在Qualcomm Hexagon NPU上部署的实际问题。
en_tdlr: DCM-SAM, a defect-conditioned mixture of LoRA experts trained solely on synthetic slices with only 4.4% of parameters updated, achieves 64.2% pore IoU on real NIST scans without ever seeing real images during training, while deployment on a Qualcomm Hexagon NPU reveals that ViT-H and ViT-L fail to allocate memory at 1024×1024 resolution due to activations exceeding device limits.
